issues.title: Revenue Calculation Error
issues.problem: The revenue calculation does not filter by status 'COMPLETED' as per business rules.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue

issues.title: Inefficient Correlated Subquery
issues.line: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS t2 WHERE t2.CUSTOMER_ID = ft.CUSTOMER_ID) as customer_txns
issues.problem: The correlated subquery can be very inefficient as it runs for each row in the outer query.
issues.fix: COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.CUSTOMER_ID) as customer_txns

issues.title: Lack of Comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining the logic, especially around the revenue calculation and customer transaction count.
issues.fix: Add comments explaining the logic of revenue calculation and customer transaction count.

issues.title: Inconsistent Naming
issues.problem: The table alias 'ft' is used inconsistently with both uppercase and lowercase.
issues.fix: Use consistent casing for table aliases, e.g., 'ft'

review.corrected_sql:
-- Customer transaction summary with corrected bugs
SELECT 
    ft.CUSTOMER_ID,
    ft.MERCHANT_ID,
    COUNT(*) as txn_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.CUSTOMER_ID) as customer_txns
FROM FACT_TRANSACTIONS ft
LEFT JOIN DIM_MERCHANT dm ON ft.MERCHANT_ID = dm.MERCHANT_ID
WHERE ft.TRANSACTION_DATE >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY ft.CUSTOMER_ID, ft.MERCHANT_ID
review.summary: The query had critical correctness issues with revenue calculation and performance issues with a correlated subquery. Readability was also improved by adding comments and ensuring consistent naming.
